// note: This project is plain JavaScript. `npm run typecheck` runs tsc over it in checkJs mode - not to add TypeScript, but to catch the class of mistake that costs the most here: a renamed prop, a typo'd import, a call with the wrong number of arguments. Type inference plus JSDoc gets most of that with no source changes and no build-step cost. `strict` stays off deliberately: turning it on against untyped React code produces hundreds of implicit-any complaints that would bury the real findings.
